- Shift existing staff: Dev can pick up Marta's evening slot; Jon can take the teardown (if agreed).
- Engage Luma for a local temp to cover one evening shift (you mentioned availability on short notice).

Attachments: CHI-roadshow-itinerary-v3.pdf (updated timing), Agent_Roster_final.csv (current staffing).

1) Dev / Marissa: can either of you cover the evening slot or escalate flight booking for a contractor? If booking a contractor, include approval code for expedited travel.
2) Luma: confirm local temp rates and whether they can pick up badge pre-check at the hotel (we need them in demo systems by 09:30 on 11/10).
3) Sarah / SparkFrame: will you be able to accept an alternate staffer for Marta's scheduled meetings, or should we try to keep the same handoff?

I’ll consolidate responses and send the formal travel/expense note. Thanks all — need final by 17:00 CST.
